releases.new: Load any Salesforce sObject, standard or custom, with the new salesforce_table source.
releases.breaking: Naive scd2 timestamps are no longer treated as UTC, so a naive active_record_timestamp may stop matching active records; pass timezone-aware values.

releases.new: Load full snapshots with the new cdc merge strategy, which upserts rows and deletes destination rows missing from the snapshot.
releases.breaking: Removed pendulum helpers like ensure_pendulum_datetime_utc from dlt.common.time and pendulum 3 is now required; switch to ensure_datetime_in_tz and upgrade pendulum.

releases.new: Join datasets that live on different destinations in a single query using the dataset table join method.
releases.breaking: Failed load packages no longer auto-abort and raise LoadClientJobTerminalRetry instead of LoadClientJobFailed; set auto_abort_on_terminal_error to True to restore old behavior.

releases.new: Declare runner instance requirements for jobs through require.instance, such as a size of medium.
Replace ClickHouse tables atomically with the staging-optimized strategy, so a full replace never leaves the destination half-loaded.
Merge data into SQLAlchemy destinations using the new merge write disposition support.
Use a custom requests session with the REST API source to control how HTTP calls are made.
Load data into any SQL database supported by SQLAlchemy using the new SQLAlchemy destination.
releases.breaking: The complex data type is deprecated and renamed to json, and foreign_key is dropped; update schemas and hints accordingly.

releases.new: Partition delta tables when loading data, using the newly added delta table partitioning support.
Start load jobs continuously as loader slots free up, speeding up loading of packages with many files.
releases.breaking: DuckDB and MotherDuck parquet loads now match columns by name, so files relying on column order may load differently.
